subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow raw bracketed button JSON fallback for Gemini final replies, or require Gemini/provider prompting to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source shows the structured-only gap, but raw final-text parsing would expand the model-visible output contract and affect transcript plus channel-presentation behavior.

options.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow constrained parsing only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on provider/tool prompting that emits typed message-tool buttons.

options.title: Hold For Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow constrained parsing only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The active candidate PR requests steipete's review and the decision crosses Telegram controls, typed presentation, and final-reply product behavior.
